count_discrepancy_note: Bandai Namco's current official game page advertises 32 mentors, while the community mentor index lists 33 available mentors including DLC. This is retained as a reconciliation item rather than silently choosing a count.

system_rules.mentor_relationships: Mentors can act as instructors, provide training missions, unlock unique skills, and build friendship.
system_rules.friendship_rewards: Max friendship can unlock a mentor-specific Dual Ultimate and fills a Partner Gauge.
system_rules.appearance_rules: Mentor availability depends on story progression, Advancement Tests, DLC ownership, and mentor-specific conditions.
system_rules.partner_gauge: Partner Gauge can be increased through quests, Dual Ultimate usage, and Extra Story participation where supported.

next_reconciliation: Convert the cataloged mentor list into record-level lesson/reward entries and resolve the official 32-versus-community 33 count discrepancy against the current game roster.
